doc: Builtin env-var registry entries shipped with the release (tracked, sanitized — NO values, NO personal data). The EnvRegistryService merges these with the user's gitignored resources/env_registry_user.json. Each entry is metadata + the env var NAME(s); actual values live in .env (kind=value) or pods (kind=secret / account.auth). owner = user|assistant (UI grouping, maps to PRINCIPAL_USER/PRINCIPAL_SELF). feature = freeform tag a feature page filters on. Env var names here still use the current EMI_* spelling so today's readers resolve; the rename to ASSISTANT_* happens with the reader migration (registry holds whatever the install uses).

entries.name: PRIMARY_USER
entries.label: Your name

auth.secret_hint: Generate at Bluesky Settings -> Privacy and Security -> App Passwords. Looks like abcd-efgh-ijkl-mnop.
Generate at developer.x.com under your project's app keys. Paid tier required for write.
Create a script-type app at reddit.com/prefs/apps; use the OAuth token, not the secret.
Talk to @BotFather on Telegram; create a new bot; copy the HTTP API token.
